mutants.description: Mutant 1: Assumes interest rate shocks cause zero mark-to-market loss on fixed-income reserve assets.
Mutant 2: Liquidates the least liquid assets (uninsured deposits) first before cash buffers.
Mutant 3: Returns a fixed heuristic fraction (0.50 * total_liabilities) instead of bisection search for peg break.
Mutant 4: Ignores fire-sale liquidation haircuts and assumes 100% face value conversion across all tiers.
Mutant 5: Divides remaining assets by initial liabilities instead of remaining unredeemed tokens.
